comments.preview: The email header metadata is flat: From, To and Project labels sit at the same weight as their values, and the long To recipient list crowds the row. Right-align or fix label column width, lighten the labels to a muted caption, and truncate To with a +N more chip. Group the date with the subject up top rather than floating it far right.

comments.preview: The floating AI assistant orb is visually disconnected from the product: a saturated orange gradient circle with a red notification dot, hovering with no label. It reads like a third-party chat widget rather than a native feature. Consider a labeled pill (sparkle + Ask Alleato), align it to the brand palette, and reserve the red dot for genuine unread state so it does not cry wolf.

comments.preview: Raw mail-server warnings (You dont often get email from... Learn why this is important) are rendering inline as plain body text. These are provider artifacts, not message content - they make the app look like a passthrough inbox. Either strip them on ingest or render them as a styled caution banner above the body (amber strip, shield icon) so they read as a system signal, not the senders words.

1. Replace Free-Text Billing & Shipping Addresses with Structured Company-Based Selection
Current Issue
The Bill To and Ship To sections currently use free-text address fields. This creates unnecessary risk because users can:
Mistype addresses
Enter incorrect addresses
Use inconsistent formatting
Create duplicate address recordsRequired Changes
Bill To Section
Replace the free-text Bill To field with:
Fields
Bill To Company (dropdown)
Bill To Contact (dropdown)Behavior
User selects a company.
System automatically populates:Address Line 1
Address Line 2
City
State
Zip Code
Country (if applicable)
User selects a contact associated with the selected company.
Contact dropdown should only display contacts belonging to the selected company.
Auto-populated address fields remain editable so users can override them when necessary.Ship To Section
Replace the free-text Ship To field with:
Fields
Ship To Company (dropdown)
Ship To Contact (dropdown)Behavior
User selects a company.
System automatically populates:Address Line 1
Address Line 2
City
State
Zip Code
Country (if applicable)
User selects a contact associated with the selected company.
Contact dropdown should only display employees/contacts belonging to the selected company.
Auto-populated address fields remain editable so users can override them when necessary.Acceptance Criteria
No free-text billing address field exists.
No free-text shipping address field exists.
Addresses are automatically populated from the selected company record.
Contacts are filtered by the selected company.
Users can manually edit populated address values if needed.
Address data uses the standard address component used elsewhere in the application.2. Standardize Budget Code Selection Across All Purchase Order Line Item Interfaces
Current Issue
Budget code creation and selection behavior is inconsistent across the application.
Examples:
New Purchase Order form allows creation of a new budget code.
Purchase Order detail page line item entry does not allow creation of a new budget code.
SOV tab does not allow creation of a new budget code.
Edit Purchase Order page does allow creation of a new budget code.This indicates that different implementations or components are being used for the same workflow.
Required Changes
Perform a full audit of every interface that allows:
Adding line items
Editing line items
Managing Schedule of Values (SOV)
Creating commitments
Creating purchase ordersStandardization Requirements
All line-item-related interfaces must use the same reusable component and configuration.
The following functionality must be identical everywhere:
Budget code search
Budget code selection
Budget code creation
Cost code selection
Category selection
Validation rules
Default values
PermissionsAcceptance Criteria
Budget code creation is available everywhere line items can be added.
Budget code creation behavior is identical across all pages.
Budget code search behavior is identical across all pages.
No page contains a custom or hand-built implementation that differs from the standard component.
All line-item workflows use the same shared component.3. Schedule of Values (SOV) Editing Rules
Business Rule
Users should be able to add, edit, and manage Schedule of Values (SOV) line items at any time while the Purchase Order remains unapproved.
Required Behavior
Allow SOV modifications when Purchase Order status is:
Draft
Pending
Under Review
Returned
Any other non-approved statusRestrict SOV modifications when Purchase Order status is:
Approved
Closed
Voided (if applicable)Acceptance Criteria
Users can add line items to the SOV after the Purchase Order has been created.
Users can create new budget codes during SOV editing.
Users can edit existing SOV line items.
Users can delete SOV line items (subject to permission rules).
SOV editing remains available until the Purchase Order reaches Approved status.
Once Approved, SOV becomes read-only unless the Purchase Order is formally reopened or revised.
